changes.title: Large statistics
changes.text: Large means and medians retain their represented values instead of overflowing display rounding.

changes.title: Statistics startup
changes.text: Concurrent statistics initialization no longer deadlocks while registering built-in facts.

changes.title: Conservative rate bounds
changes.text: Incomplete question rates now round outward so their displayed bounds remain conservative.

changes.title: Empty recorded values
changes.text: Text filters offer known empty values separately from missing recordings.

changes.title: Regression coverage
changes.text: Added reproduced startup, large-number, rate-rounding and empty-filter cases with native Android answer and picker checks.

changes.title: Save-test isolation
changes.text: Save regressions restore their temporary file services after execution and use names describing their verified behavior.

changes.title: Armor generation study
changes.text: Verified 100,000 TEST79 dungeon seeds without changing loot probabilities; generated armor and player encounters remain distinct.

changes.title: Verification records
changes.text: Recorded the preceding delivered APK and this batch's evidence and build checks.

changes.title: Developer Commentary
changes.text: I fixed several misleading statistics displays and an initialization deadlock. Empty recorded values are now selectable without treating missing data as empty.
